title: Rack or shelf form
purpose: Add a rack, tower, shelf or canister to a unit, or change the name of an existing one.
summary: Add a rack, tower, shelf or canister to a unit, or change the name of an existing one.

tasks.title: Add a rack or shelf
steps: Choose the [[Storage unit]], where it sits in [[Inside]], its [[Slot]] and [[Kind]].
Type the [[Code]] and [[Name]], then give [[Node slots]] or [[Box slots]], not both.

tasks.title: Rename it
steps: Change the [[Name]], give the [[Reason for the change]] and select [[Save changes]].

good_to_know: Only the name can be changed later. Use Move to relocate it.
A shelf holds racks; a rack, tower or canister holds shelves.
Codes are stored in capitals and never reused.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Only the admin and manager roles can open or submit this form.
Only the name can be edited later; moving a node uses the Move action. Opening the form from a unit or node page preselects the unit, and the parent and first kind that can be held.

items.label: Inside
items.description: Create only. Optional. Leave as Top level of the unit, or choose a node that offers node slots. Must belong to the chosen unit.

items.label: Slot
items.description: Create only. Required whole number, at least 1. Inside a parent it can be no higher than the parent's node slots. Must be unused by another active node in the same place.

items.label: Kind
items.description: Create only. Shelf, Rack, Tower or Canister. A shelf holds racks; a rack, tower or canister holds shelves. Any kind may stand at the top level. Layouts are at most 4 levels deep.

items.label: Code
items.description: Create only. Up to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit. Stored in capitals. It can never be changed or reused, even after retirement.

items.label: Node slots
items.description: Create only. 0 to 100: how many shelves or racks it holds.

items.label: Box slots
items.description: Create only. 0 to 100: how many boxes it holds directly. Give node slots or box slots, one of them and not both.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Edit only. Required, up to 2000 characters. Kept in the history.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Editing needs a reason (up to 2000 characters), which is kept in the history with the values before and after. Creating records the setup without asking for a reason. If the record changed since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay on the page, but check the current values before saving again. A save with nothing changed is refused.
